translations.web: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
translations.bsb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
translations.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
translations.asv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.
